messages:
alex: Quick follow-up to the evictor-histogram RFC — thinking about per-tenant adaptive thresholds to avoid noisy evictions during short bursts. Sketch: keep 1m / 5m histograms, compute p95, set soft_threshold = max(global_min, p95 * 1.5). Thoughts?

maria: I like per-tenant but worried about cold tenants skewing the p95. Need smoothing + min-samples.

jon: Can we use an EWMA over the p95 estimate? cheap and stabilizes spikes.

alex: yeah EWMA makes sense. Proposed: ewma_p95 <- alpha * sample_p95 + (1-alpha) * ewma_p95, alpha=0.3 fallback to global when samples < 100.

sam: How does this interact with compactness/defrag? If we raise thresholds we reduce eviction pressure -> could increase fragmentation.

maria: Good call. Maybe only adjust soft_threshold, keep hard_threshold unchanged so we don't starve the compactors.

jon: Also add a burst detector: if burst_duration < 10s ignore adjustments (treat as transient).

alex: Implementation notes: histogram buckets are per-second token counts; storing 300s (5m) with 64 compressed buckets looks ok. Formula sketch:```
soft = max(global_min, ewma_p95 * 1.5)
hard = configured_hard_threshold
```Cost ballpark: 64 buckets * 8 bytes ~= 512B per tenant (plus overhead).

ci-bot: deploy pipeline note: feature-flag "evictor.hist.adaptive" created, default off for prod, enable in canary pool.

sam: Perf test plan: synthetic bursts + mixed tenants, measure eviction_rate, p99 latency, and compact_cycles.

alex: Action items: (1) I'll open a prototype PR behind the feature flag, (2) @maria will draft smoothing/min-sample params, (3) @jon will add burst-detector stub. If no objections we can start canarying next week. :thumbsup:

maria: ack — will add min_samples=120 and ewma_alpha=0.25 to the doc.

jon: ack — will stub burst detector and add unit tests for transient detection.

sam: ack — will wire perf harness and report back after 24h run on canary pool.
